candidates.name: Mavi New York
candidates.partition_evidence: Homepage says it is an 'authorized distributor and installer of commercial toilet partitions' and offers union, prevailing-wage and non-union installation in the NY Metro and Tri-State area.
red_flags: Sells partitions directly (authorized distributor of ASI, Bobrick, Bradley, Hadrian, Metpar, Scranton), so it competes with Next Partitions on supply: high buy-around risk
candidates.reason: Commercial toilet partition installer based in Queens with stated union and non-union crews. It is also a direct partition distributor, so it is a buy-around risk.

candidates.name: Division10, Inc.
candidates.partition_evidence: About page lists 'Toilet Partitions (furnish & install)'. The projects page lists many Manhattan commercial clients (banks, law firms, offices).
red_flags: Furnishes partitions itself (supplier to GCs): buy-around risk
Dated website with little detail; NY and NJ MBE certified according to the about page
candidates.reason: Furnishes and installs toilet partitions for general contractors on NYC commercial fit-outs since 2002. It also supplies partitions, so it is a buy-around risk.

candidates.name: Inter-Co Division 10 (New Jersey), Inc.
candidates.partition_evidence: Homepage says it supplies and installs specialty products, with toilet partitions among its core lines, on offices, hospitals, schools, hotels and stadiums.
red_flags: Large distributor that supplies partitions (12 offices in Canada and the US): high buy-around risk
Base city conflicts between pages: the contact page gives Kearny, NJ, while modulexcorp.com says the former Modulex operation continues in Hillside, NJ
candidates.reason: Supplies and installs toilet partitions on commercial projects from its NY/NJ office. Since February 2025 this office includes the former Modulex Partitions. It is a large distributor, so it is a buy-around risk.

candidates.name: Benco Inc.
candidates.partition_evidence: Site title reads 'NY, NJ Division 10 product sales and installation'. Toilet partitions are its first product line, and the site says 'We Are Proud to Sell and Install Products From These Industry Leading Brands' and mentions 'quality installation'.
red_flags: Distributor since 1970 that sells partitions: buy-around risk
Brand logos are images without names, so brands were not confirmed
candidates.reason: A Division 10 distributor that sells and installs toilet partitions for commercial projects in NJ and NY. No project photos could be checked.

candidates.name: Partition Stalls
candidates.partition_evidence: Homepage offers installation of commercial toilet partitions in NY, NJ, PA, CT, FL, TX, CA and DE, with scope confirmed per project.
red_flags: Online partition seller with instant pricing and nationwide supply: a direct competitor of Next Partitions and a high buy-around risk
candidates.reason: Installs commercial partitions in NY and NJ. It is effectively a direct online competitor selling the same brands, so it should be approached with care.

candidates.name: 10-SPEC
candidates.partition_evidence: Homepage lists Partition Installation as a service: 'Our skilled and experienced installers complete any commercial bathroom partitions installation'. It also lists field measurement and removal of old compartments.
red_flags: Describes itself as a distributor of partition stalls and parts: buy-around risk
Marlboro is about 30 miles from the area center
candidates.reason: Installs commercial bathroom partitions in NJ, NY, PA and CT and names ASI, Bobrick, Hadrian and Scranton. It is also a distributor, and its base is at the edge of the 30-mile range.

candidates.name: Connecticut Restroom Specialties (CRS)
candidates.partition_evidence: Homepage describes full service from restroom layout 'through the final installation' by factory-trained installers. Toilet partitions are its first product line, the projects page has many photos, and the vendors page shows Bobrick, ASI, Scranton and Hadrian logos.
red_flags: Danbury is about 40 to 55 miles from the area, outside the 30-mile range
Distributor of Division 10 products: buy-around risk
candidates.reason: A real commercial partition installer that says it serves the tri-state area, but its base is outside the 30-mile range. It is a candidate for a Connecticut or Westchester area instead.

candidates.name: Modulex Partition Corporation
candidates.partition_evidence: modulexcorp.com now says Modulex was acquired by Inter-Co Division 10 on 2025-02-01 and operates as Inter-Co Division 10 (New Jersey) Inc.
red_flags: No longer a separate business: duplicate of Inter-Co Division 10 (New Jersey)
www.modulexcorp.com did not resolve; the bare domain shows the acquisition notice
candidates.reason: Rejected as a duplicate. Modulex was acquired by Inter-Co in February 2025 and is covered by the Inter-Co entry.

candidates.name: Nationwide Maintenance Inc.
candidates.partition_evidence: Homepage lists general construction, maintenance and kitchen and bath remodels. It does not mention toilet partitions.
red_flags: General contractor and maintenance firm, not a partition installer
candidates.reason: A general contractor and maintenance company with no partition installation shown.
